sentences.text:
Indian Penal Code And Section 6 And 17 Of ... vs In Re : Saddam
Mondal & Anr on 16 January, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 16.01.2024  17 Ct. No. 29  S.D.
REJECTED  C.R.M.(A) 108 of 2024  In Re:- In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection  with Kultali Police Station Case No. 644 of 2019 dated  05.10.2023 under Section 376(5)(N)/376(3)/109/34 of the  Indian Penal Code and Section 6 and 17 of the POCSO Act.
 And  In Re : Saddam Mondal & Anr.
 ...... petitioners  Mr. Lakshminath Bhattacharya  ...for the petitioners  Mr. Pinak Kumar Mitra  ...for the State  Petitioners before us pray for anticipatory bail.
 Learned advocate appearing for the petitioners submits  that there is a delay in lodgement of the FIR.
It is claimed as against the petitioners  that they are acquaintance of the principal accused.
Police filed  charge sheet and, therefore, custodial interrogation of the  petitioners is not required.
Learned advocate appearing for the State draws the  attention of the Court to the materials in the case diary.
We perused the materials in the case diary.

Indian Penal Code And Section 6 And 17 Of ... vs In Re : Saddam Mondal & Anr on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67388642/
1  Apparently, there was a relationship between the  principal accused and a person who was a minor.
2  The materials in the case dairy implicate the petitioners in assisting the principal accused in keeping a relationship with the minor.
Considering the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioners, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to any of the petitioners and the prayer of anticipatory bail is rejected.
The application being CRM (A) 108 of 2024 is dismissed.
Although the defacto-complainant was not arranged as a party respondent in the instant application, such defacto- complainant was served.
Affidavit of service in this regard filed in Court be taken on record.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
